name: PoloDB
tagline: Embedded BSON document database for Rust with a MongoDB-like API and optional wire-protocol server.
description: PoloDB is an embedded document database for Rust that stores BSON documents and exposes collections, filters, update operators, indexes, aggregation and transactions through a typed, serde-friendly API modelled on the MongoDB driver. Since v5 it uses RocksDB for storage, and a standalone server mode speaks part of the MongoDB wire protocol so existing drivers can connect. There are also experimental Python bindings. Releases are steady (v5.3.0 in July 2026), but the maintainers note that indexes, aggregation and the server are still evolving. It suits Rust desktop, CLI and edge apps that want MongoDB-style documents without a server.
strengths: Idiomatic, typed Rust API with serde integration
MongoDB-style queries, updates and aggregation in-process
RocksDB storage gives solid durability and compression
Optional server mode works with standard MongoDB drivers for supported operations
weaknesses: Young project; APIs and features still evolving
Database is a RocksDB directory, not a single portable file
First build compiles RocksDB and is slow
useCases: Rust desktop and CLI apps needing local document storage
Edge services wanting MongoDB-like semantics without a server
Tests that stub MongoDB with an embedded store
